intro.p: WrenchNow is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights.

blocks.p: Information you provide directly:

ul: Name, email address, and password when you create an account
Vehicle information (year, make, model) when booking a service
Location or address when booking a service
Payment information (processed and stored by Stripe — we never see or store your card number)
Service descriptions and notes you provide when booking
Reviews and ratings you submit
Information you provide when applying as a Mechanic, including professional experience and qualifications

blocks.p: Information collected automatically:

ul: IP address and general location data
Browser type and device information
Pages visited and features used on the platform
Booking and transaction history
To operate and improve the WrenchNow platform
To connect you with Mechanics or Customers
To process payments and send booking confirmations
To send service reminders and re-engagement communications
To verify the identity and credentials of Mechanics
To investigate disputes, fraud, or misuse of the platform
To comply with legal obligations
To communicate platform updates, new features, and promotional offers (you may opt out at any time)

blocks.p: We do not sell your personal information. We share information only in the following circumstances:
With Mechanics:

ul: When you book a service, we share your name, vehicle information, and service address with the Mechanic you have selected

blocks.p: With Customers:

ul: Mechanic profiles including name, location, specialties, ratings, and verified job prices are visible to all users

blocks.p: With service providers:

ul: We use Supabase (database), Stripe (payments), Checkr (Mechanic background checks), and Resend (email) to operate the platform. These providers process data on our behalf under confidentiality obligations

blocks.p: For legal reasons:

ul: We may disclose information if required by law, court order, or to protect the rights and safety of WrenchNow, its users, or the public

blocks.p: Business transfers:

ul: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction

blocks.p: We retain your account information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services. Booking records are retained for a minimum of 7 years for legal and tax compliance purposes. You may request deletion of your personal data at any time (subject to legal retention requirements) by emailing privacy@getwrenchnow.com.

We use industry-standard security measures to protect your information, including encrypted data transmission (HTTPS), row-level security on our database, and secure third-party payment processing through Stripe. We never store payment card numbers. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
WrenchNow uses essential cookies to keep you signed in and to secure your session. We do not use third-party advertising trackers.
Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:
Access:

ul: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you

blocks.p: Correction:

ul: Request correction of inaccurate data

blocks.p: Deletion:

ul: Request deletion of your personal data (subject to legal obligations)

blocks.p: Portability:

ul: Request your data in a machine-readable format

blocks.p: Objection:

ul: Object to processing of your data for marketing purposes

blocks.p: Withdrawal of consent:

ul: Withdraw consent for data processing where consent is the legal basis

blocks.p: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@getwrenchnow.com. We will respond within 30 days.

WrenchNow is not intended for use by persons under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us immediately.

Your data may be processed and stored in countries other than your own. By using WrenchNow, you consent to the transfer of your information to countries that may have different data protection laws than your country of residence.
The platform may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those websites and encourage you to review their privacy policies.

sections.heading: 11. GDPR — Users in the European Economic Area

blocks.p: If you are located in the EEA, our legal basis for processing your personal data is: (a) performance of a contract when we process data to provide our services; (b) legitimate interests when we improve the platform and prevent fraud; (c) compliance with legal obligations; and (d) consent where you have provided it. You have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

California residents have the right to know what personal information is collected, to request deletion of personal information, and to opt out of the sale of personal information. WrenchNow does not sell personal information. To exercise your rights under the CCPA, contact us at privacy@getwrenchnow.com.

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes by updating the "Last updated" date. Your continued use of the platform constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.
For privacy-related questions or requests, contact us at privacy@getwrenchnow.com.

intro.p: By submitting an application to join WrenchNow and by performing any services through the platform, you ("Mechanic") agree to this Independent Contractor Agreement with WrenchNow ("WrenchNow").

blocks.p: You are an independent contractor, not an employee of WrenchNow.
This Agreement does not create an employment relationship, agency, partnership, or joint venture. You have no authority to bind WrenchNow to any contract or obligation.
As an independent contractor, you are solely responsible for:

ul: All taxes arising from payments received through WrenchNow, including self-employment tax
Obtaining and maintaining all required licences, certifications, and permits to perform automotive services in your jurisdiction
Providing your own tools, equipment, and supplies
Setting your own working hours and schedule
Determining how services are performed, subject to customer requirements
Complying with all applicable laws and regulations

blocks.p: By applying to WrenchNow, you represent and warrant that:

ul: You are at least 18 years of age
You have the legal right to work in the jurisdiction where you will provide services
All information you provide in your application is accurate and complete
You hold all licences, certifications, and qualifications required by applicable law to perform the services you offer
You have not been convicted of a crime that would reasonably disqualify you from working with members of the public
You are in good health and physically capable of performing automotive services safely
You will maintain the accuracy of your profile information at all times

blocks.p: You are required to maintain, at your own expense, adequate insurance coverage to protect yourself and your customers, including:

ul: General liability insurance (recommended minimum: $1,000,000 per occurrence)
Garage keeper's liability or on-hook towing insurance if applicable
Workers' compensation insurance if required by your jurisdiction
Any other insurance required by applicable law

blocks.p: WrenchNow does not provide insurance coverage for Mechanics or their work. WrenchNow is not responsible for any claims, losses, or damages arising from your failure to maintain adequate insurance.
You agree to:

ul: Perform all services in a professional, workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards
Use appropriate parts and materials for each job
Communicate clearly with customers about the scope, cost, and timeline of work before beginning
Obtain customer approval before performing any work beyond the original agreed scope
Leave the customer's vehicle and property in the same or better condition than found
Respond promptly to booking notifications and customer communications
Arrive within the agreed time window or notify the customer immediately of any delay

blocks.p: You agree not to:

ul: Perform services while impaired by alcohol, drugs, or any substance
Misrepresent your qualifications, experience, or the services you provide
Charge amounts beyond those agreed with the customer and disclosed on the platform
Circumvent the WrenchNow platform by arranging direct payments with customers outside the platform
Harass, intimidate, or behave inappropriately toward any customer
Share customer personal information with any third party
Use WrenchNow for any unlawful purpose
Damage a customer's vehicle, property, or any third-party property intentionally or through gross negligence
Solicit customers to use your services outside the WrenchNow platform for 12 months after your last booking through WrenchNow
